line.materials.title: Material & plating, in plain numbers
line.steel.pvd.title: PVD vs water plating
line.steel.pvd.desc: PVD bonds the layer in a vacuum chamber; water plating deposits it in a bath. PVD resists wear longer — thickness is stated on every spec sheet.
line.steel.316l.title: 316L vs 304
line.steel.316l.desc: 316L adds molybdenum for chloride resistance — the grade we use for pieces worn against skin.
line.steel.corrosion.title: Corrosion, explained
line.steel.corrosion.desc: Salt-spray behavior is a test result, not a promise. Every batch is sent for testing and the report travels with your quotation.
line.stone.dictionary.title: Stone dictionary
line.stone.natural.title: Natural variation is not a defect
line.stone.natural.desc: Veining, tone shifts and inclusion are what natural stone is. We photograph the parcel you are buying so what you approve is what ships.
line.position.title: How this line is positioned

compliance.title: Compliance & testing
compliance.status.title: What we can and cannot show you today
compliance.status.body1: We do not keep a library of finished test reports on this site. What we do is send every batch for testing and hand you the report with your quotation — linked to the exact alloy, plating and batch you are buying.
compliance.status.body2: Until then, here is how to read a report, and the three questions that separate a real one from a bought one.
compliance.standards.title: The standards, and what they actually require
compliance.standard.nickel: Nickel release — REACH Annex XVII Entry 27. EN 1811 for uncoated articles, EN 12472 wear simulation for coated. Limit 0.5 µg/cm²/week; pierced articles 0.2.
compliance.standard.lead: Lead — REACH Annex XVII Entry 63, ≤0.05% w/w.
compliance.standard.cadmium: Cadmium — REACH Annex XVII Entry 23, ≤0.01% w/w.
compliance.standard.cpsia: CPSIA — US children's product lead limits, applicable to children's jewelry.
compliance.standard.prop65: California Prop 65 — warning obligations for listed substances.
compliance.standard.astm: ASTM F2999 / F2923 — US consumer safety specifications for adult and children's jewelry.
compliance.verify.title: How to verify a test report
compliance.verify.body: Cross-check the report number with the issuing laboratory. A report without all four attributes — standard, laboratory, report number, date — is not evidence.
compliance.batch.title: Per-batch testing, in writing
compliance.batch.body: Test reports are issued per batch and provided with your quotation for the matching product.
compliance.request.title: Request the latest report
compliance.request.body: Tell us the SKU and destination market; the report for the matching batch is attached to your quotation.
compliance.nickelArticle.title: Nickel release & EN 1811, explained
compliance.nickelArticle.intro: EN 1811 is the reference method EU importers use to check nickel release from articles in direct and prolonged skin contact. Results are stated per square centimetre per week, after the wear simulation defined in EN 12472.
compliance.nickelArticle.limitCoated: Coated articles: 0.5 µg/cm²/week after EN 12472 wear simulation.
compliance.nickelArticle.limitPierced: Pierced articles — ear posts and similar: 0.2 µg/cm²/week, no exceptions.
compliance.nickelArticle.failures: Common failures: plating below stated thickness, unverified base alloy, and reports issued without wear simulation.

sourcing.title: Sourcing partners & QC
sourcing.intro: We do not own a factory. We buy from a vetted workshop network, audited per lot, and we inspect every order before it ships. What we sell is specification accuracy and reply speed.
sourcing.qc.title: Three-step quality control
sourcing.qc.step1: Incoming inspection — base material and plating thickness checked against the spec sheet.
sourcing.qc.step2: In-process checks — the workshop's output is sampled against the agreed AQL plan.
sourcing.qc.step3: Pre-shipment inspection — every lot is inspected against an agreed AQL sampling plan; the level is written into your order.
